name: Summary Amounts 2
definition: Provides amounts taken in to account to calculate the collateral position.

ThresholdAmount.name: Threshold Amount
ThresholdAmount.definition: Amount of unsecured exposure a counterparty will accept before issuing a margin call in the base currency.

ThresholdType.name: Threshold Type
ThresholdType.definition: Specifies if the threshold amount is secured or unsecured.

PreHaircutCollateralValue.name: Pre Haircut Collateral Value
PreHaircutCollateralValue.definition: Total value of posted collateral (pre-haircut) held by the taker.

ReturnExcessCashAndCollateralCurrency.name: Return Excess Cash And Collateral Currency
ReturnExcessCashAndCollateralCurrency.definition: Indicates if excess cash collateral in the currency is automatically returned as per the collateral provider’s Excess Cash Margin Instruction (colr.017).

MinimumTransferAmount.name: Minimum Transfer Amount
MinimumTransferAmount.definition: Minimum amount to pay/receive as specified in the agreement in the base currency (to avoid the need to transfer an inconveniently small amount of collateral).

RoundingAmount.name: Rounding Amount
RoundingAmount.definition: Amount specified to avoid the need to transfer uneven amounts of collateral.

PreviousCollateralValue.name: Previous Collateral Value
PreviousCollateralValue.definition: Value of collateral at previous valuation.

TotalPendingIncomingCollateral.name: Total Pending Incoming Collateral
TotalPendingIncomingCollateral.definition: Value of incoming collateral, to be settled.

TotalPendingOutgoingCollateral.name: Total Pending Outgoing Collateral
TotalPendingOutgoingCollateral.definition: Value of outgoing collateral, to be settled.
